description: Green-panel allowlist for DS gate ratchet (Survivor #6). Files listed here run DS rules in strict-zero mode (must have ZERO chrome-gate violations, not just baseline-parity). Additions are one-way doors.
mechanism: On each gate run, a file in `files` is counted separately. Any violation (gradient / raw shadow / radius>4 / magic layout literal) fails CI for that file, regardless of overall baseline.
notes: Week 3 Part 3 (tonight): added 12 shared/ui primitives after a quick tokenization pass (50% → radius-full, raw shadows → shadow tokens). All files verified ZERO chrome-gate violations.
Week 3 Part 1 (commit 32c1737) + Part 2 (commit e515272): SettingsTab + PagesTab container migrations.
Sub-screens (9 Settings screens) and sub-components (PageList / PageRow / etc.) are NOT yet in this list — their CSS files still have some violations counted against the overall baseline.
Do NOT remove files from this list once added. If a migration regresses, fix the code — removing from the allowlist hides the regression.
